subject: Contingency coverage & short-term uptime guarantee request
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@finacea.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intermittent 5-10m outages this week — need options

Hi Neha,

We had three incidents over the past five days where API calls to the /generate endpoint returned 502 or timed out for ~5–10 minutes each time. These impacted critical parts of our fraud detection pipeline and caused backfills. My ops team ran a quick triage and they flagged tail-latency spikes during peak window as the likely driver.

We love Redwood and are in the middle of renewal conversations for our enterprise plan, but this variability has made our procurement and security teams nervous. They want to know: what commercial or operational options do we have to reduce our exposure while you stabilize? Specifically: can we get a short-term SLA uplift or an interim operational commitment (credits, guaranteed continuity, or a prioritized path to a premium tier) while you finish the mitigation work?

We also need any documents your team can share for procurement (a short addendum or statement of continuity, and an ops report). Can we hop on a quick sync to align? I can do Wednesday morning PT.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Engineering, Finacea
ops@finacea.com

Attachments: uptime-sample-logs.txt (10KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@finacea.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Intermittent 5-10m outages this week — need options

Samir — thanks for the note and I'm really sorry about the interruptions.

We take incidents like this very seriously. I can run through the timeline and our remediation plan, and Ben (cc'd) will bring the commercial options. We can do a 30-minute call Wednesday 9:30am PT — does that work?

I'll prepare a short ops summary and an initial contingency addendum for procurement so you have something to review in the call.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0142
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent 5-10m outages this week — need options

Folks — looping you in after the Finacea escalation. Key points: they experienced three ~5–10m 502/timeouts over five days, impact to fraud pipeline, procurement asking for short-term contractual assurances while we finish mitigations.

What I think we can offer as a defensible, low-friction option: a 60-day "continuity commitment" addendum that includes:
- A temporary SLO of 99.95% availability for their primary EU/US region (targeted to the endpoints they use)
- A defined credit formula for breaches (pro-rated monthly credit)
- Priority incident routing (direct escalation to our incident manager)
- A 10% credit on next renewal for signing the addendum within 7 days

Operational caveats: this is a short-term commercial gesture, not a permanent SLA change. Engineering: can we promise the 60-day operational support and the priority channel? Rishi — can you confirm we can limit the scope to specific endpoints and region? Marissa — is 10% credit on renewal something we can approve for this stage (deal is at expansion/renewal stage)?

I'll attach the draft addendum I plan to send to Samir and bring these options on the call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Neha

Attachments: proposed-contingency-addendum.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intermittent 5-10m outages this week — need options

Copy — I support a short-term contingent addendum. A few clarifications before we send:
- Credit: recommend a simple credit of 5% of their monthly invoice per qualifying incident (capped at 20% per month) — keeps math simple and avoids open-ended liability.
- Timebox: 45–60 days (lean toward 45 if engineering is confident in mitigation velocity).
- Scope: explicitly list the affected endpoints and regions (we can exclude experimental or beta routes).
- DocuSign: use a 7-day signature window to keep procurement moving.

Marissa — if you can confirm commercial approach (credit & renewal incentive) I can draft the HubSpot amendment and prepare a DocuSign packet. Rishi — can you confirm the prioritization channel and that Engineering can commit to the temporary support SLA?

If we're aligned, I'll share the DocuSign link and the addendum to Samir after today's call.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@finacea.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Contingency coverage proposal — 45-day continuity addendum (draft)

Samir — thanks again for your time last week and for walking us through the impact. Per our discussion, attached is a short draft addendum that provides a timeboxed commercial and operational commitment while we finish the engineering mitigations. Highlights:

- Term: 45 days from effective date
- Coverage: 99.95% availability for /generate and /chat endpoints in your primary region (US)
- Credit: 5% of monthly invoice per qualifying incident, capped at 20% per month
- Priority routing: Finacea gets a dedicated escalation queue and direct pager contact to our incident manager during the 45-day window
- Procurement incentive: sign within 7 days and receive a 7% credit on the next renewal term

We attached: uptime-report-Nov-2026.pdf (ops summary of incidents) and proposed-contingency-addendum.docx (contract language). Link to DocuSign and HubSpot record below.

DocuSign: https://docusign.company/send/abc123
HubSpot Deal: https://hubspot.company/deal/DEAL-8731
Drive: https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

If this looks reasonable I can send the DocuSign package today. If you need procurement language changed, loop in your legal and share comments — we'll be flexible on minor wording.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0142
